title: Interview with The Honorable Paul Hellyer, Former Minister of National Defence & Deputy PM of Canada
channel: Carl Jung Depth Psychology Reading Group
description:
This interview was conducted on May 13, 2019.

Paul Theodore Hellyer, PC is a Canadian engineer, politician, writer, and commentator who has had a long and varied career. He is the longest serving current member of the Privy Council of Canada, just ahead of Prince Philip, and a former Minister of National Defence, Transportation, and Deputy Prime Minister of Canada.  https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paul_Hellyer 

I am grateful to Mr. Myles Flaig of Calgary, Alberta, Canada for arranging this interview.  

00:37--_Hope Restored_--God is alive, well, and everywhere.

02:25--The first problem is disclosure. The government of the United States has been keeping secret major issues that are of profound importance to the People.  

07:52--Secrets of the elite banking families.  

12:17--Skip's experience on September 8, 2015--The Crash of 2008.

13:20--The whole financial system is a stack of cards.

14:44--_The Money Mafia_ by Paul Hellyer.

16:20--"For many years we've given these rich families a monopoly to create money."

21:10--"Hellyer demonstrates that God is alive, well, and everywhere and that humanity's choice is between the dark and the light."

21:57--"I get answers and I know."

23:05--"The whole cosmos is connected."

24:52--"After I went public on UFOs ... Edgar Mitchell wanted to meet me."

26:14--"Edgar Mitchell said, 'I believe the Universe is God's body.'"  Reference to Michio Kaku and the fact that Cosmology and Physics are converging.

27:09--Skip's comment on Carl Sagan and Neil deGrasse Tyson, and the fact that they can't explain dark energy and dark matter without psychological or mystical terms.

28:00--Reference to _Light at the End of the Tunnel_.

30:01--"I didn't know how much I didn't know, because I didn't know how much there was to know."

33:37--Comments on "global warming."

34:17--"As far as I'm concerned our World is on fire."

38:43--"Fortunately, normally in government we have more and more people that have developed more Consciousness."

40:38--Comments on the recent rumor that the United States is considering giving nuclear technology to the Saudis.

42:02--"We need to convert our weapons plants into zero point energy plants."

42:48--Comments on the reconciliation of the two branches of Islam.

44:10--"The world is just a big powder keg."

45:22--"Finally it will be necessary for all to forgive."

46:23--"You never get even. There's no even."

48:27--"Dr. Edward Edinger commented that [Jung] penetrated to the Source of all religions."

49:05--"Instead of finding the differences between our religions, why don't we turn around and figure out how they're the same."

49:50--Reference to Elias Canetti's _Crowds and Power_, and his teaching on how we treated the Germans after World War I and World War II.

51:15--After World War II we did the Marshall Plan.

51:51--"Certainly reconciliation and forgiveness are the only way to go."

54:00--The dichotomy between Freudian Psychology and Jungian Psychology.

54:42--"Our life, no matter how old we are, is a life that begins today, right now.  The question is, 'What will we do today to make our life better and make relationships better." Implications of 1 John 4:1.

55:24--"If we don't reconcile, then we are going to get the opposite of reconciliation."

59:24--"The reason I believe in miracles.... I know they exist."

 You can support Skip's work with a SuperChat or on Patreon here: https://www.patreon.com/SkipConover
